purpose: Master evidence stack for CITGO, PDVH, PDVSA ownership, collateral, creditor attachment, sanctions, and enforcement records.
scope_rule: This is an evidence ledger, not a valuation, current balance sheet, or final legal opinion. Ownership-chain facts, liens, claims, judgments, and attachment rights remain separate objects.

chain.relationship: shareholder of PDVH as described in the verified appellate record
holding company for CITGO Holding, Inc.
wholly owned by PDVH and parent of CITGO Petroleum Corporation
wholly owned by CITGO Holding, Inc. as described in the verified appellate record

facts.fact: Crystallex sought attachment of PDVSA shares in PDVH to satisfy a judgment against Venezuela.
facts.economic_use: Creditor-attachment and asset-encumbrance evidence; not a CITGO valuation.

facts.fact: The appellate record states that PDVSA pledged a 50.1% security interest in PDVH shares as collateral for PDVSA debt.
facts.economic_use: Collateral mapping; not proof of current ownership, lien priority, or current debt outstanding.

facts.fact: The appellate record states that PDVSA shares in PDVH were attachable under the applicable enforcement analysis.
facts.economic_use: Legal encumbrance and enforcement evidence; must not be presented as a completed sale.

facts.fact: The OI appellate record describes attachment efforts involving PDVSA shares in PDVH and the CITGO ownership chain.
facts.economic_use: Parallel-creditor and asset-enforcement evidence; do not add to the Crystallex claim.

facts.fact: The 2017 congressional hearing record discusses liens and mortgages involving portions of CITGO and PDVSA debt collateral, including a reported 49.9% interest and the other 50.1% interest.
facts.locator: PDF pp. 27, 58; transcript text anchors around CITGO lien and mortgage discussion
facts.economic_use: Contemporaneous congressional evidence and lead for primary lien documents; hearing testimony is not itself a title record or audited balance sheet.

required_next_documents: PDVSA 2020 bond trustee and payment records
PDVH, CITGO Holding, and CITGO Petroleum audited financial statements
Delaware District Court Crystallex docket, writs, sale orders, and creditor filings
CITGO valuation, dividend, cash-flow, debt, and restricted-cash records
OFAC licenses and sanctions-related authorization records
prohibited_inferences: Do not treat a lien as a completed transfer of ownership.
Do not treat an attachment order as a completed sale.
Do not treat hearing testimony as an audited financial statement.
Do not combine claim amounts from overlapping creditors.
Do not infer current CITGO enterprise value, equity value, or debt capacity from these records alone.
